meta.description: Approved goals for the Book of Intentions app. Structure: realms[] defines topic metadata per theme; goals{} is keyed by topic_id > difficulty.

easy: Write down every task weighing on your mind and pick just one to finish today.
Spend 30 minutes clearing your inbox down to only what needs a reply.
Block one hour this week with no meetings and use it only for deep work.
medium: Draft the proposal or document you have been postponing for more than a week.
Have the direct conversation with a colleague you have been avoiding.
Map out your next 30 days and identify where your time is being lost.
hard: Dedicate five focused hours this week to the single project that matters most to your long-term path.
Reach out to three people in your field you admire and start a real conversation.
Audit every recurring commitment you have and eliminate at least one that no longer serves you.

easy: Drink eight glasses of water today without exception.
Take a 20-minute walk outside before the day ends.
Sleep before midnight tonight and rise without hitting snooze.
medium: Complete four workouts this week, each at least 30 minutes long.
Cook every meal you eat for the next five days from whole ingredients.
Cut out one food or drink that you know is harming you, for the entire week.
hard: Train every morning this week before 7 AM, without negotiation.
Run or walk a total of 30 kilometres across this week.
Go one full week without alcohol, refined sugar, and processed food simultaneously.

easy: Send a message to someone you have not spoken to in over a month.
Call a family member you love and simply listen to them for 20 minutes.
Write a note of genuine appreciation to someone who has helped you recently.
medium: Plan and follow through on a meaningful evening with someone important to you.
Have an honest conversation about something you have been keeping to yourself.
Apologise sincerely to someone you have wronged, without justification.
hard: Initiate the difficult conversation in a relationship that has been quietly suffering.
Spend an entire day fully present with the people you love — no phone, no distraction.
Commit to one act of service for someone who cannot repay you, this week.

easy: Spend 30 minutes making something with no purpose other than the joy of making.
Write three pages in longhand about anything at all, without editing.
Sketch or doodle for 20 minutes before you open any screen today.
medium: Complete one creative piece — a chapter, a painting, a song — start to finish this week.
Set aside two hours each day for creative work and protect them like appointments.
Share something you have made with at least one other person, however unfinished it feels.
hard: Commit to one hour of creative practice every single morning this week before anything else.
Finish and publish or share a complete creative work by the end of this week.
Start the project you have been imagining for months and produce something tangible by Sunday.

easy: Sit in silence for ten minutes today with no phone, no music, no input.
Before bed, write three things that were genuinely good about today.
Eat one meal today slowly, without a screen, noticing every bite.
medium: Meditate for 20 minutes each morning this week, before looking at your phone.
Keep a journal entry every night this week reflecting on what you felt, not just what you did.
Spend one full afternoon this week in nature with no agenda and no device.
hard: Begin each day this week in silence for 30 minutes before speaking to anyone.
Observe a full digital sabbath — one day this week with no screens at all.
Write down every anxious thought the moment it arises each day this week, then consciously let it go.

easy: Write down every purchase you made in the last seven days and total them honestly.
Cancel one subscription you have not used in the last month.
Transfer a small amount — even symbolic — into your savings account today.
medium: Build a complete budget for next month and identify where you will cut 10% of spending.
Research and open a savings or investment account you have been putting off.
Negotiate one bill, subscription, or rate that you have been paying without questioning.
hard: Track every single penny you spend this week and sit with what it reveals about your values.
Set a concrete financial goal with a deadline and build a week-by-week plan to reach it.
Have the honest money conversation with your partner, family, or yourself that you have been avoiding.
